items.heading: First, Calm the Identity Panic
items.text: First, calm the identity panic. Do not make a lifelong decision while still reacting emotionally to one result. The first job is to separate disappointment from actual route logic.

items.heading: Run the Four Questions
items.text: Run the four questions and one proof task. Compare work style, context, market, and survival. Then test one small proof task for each serious route instead of choosing from imagination only.

items.heading: Finally, Compare Cost, College Logic,
items.text: Finally, compare cost, college logic, and family alignment. This is where you filter out panic spending, random private options, and emotional route choices that still do not fit your long-term reality.
